newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Emperor exercises option on Fiji prospect.
newsitem.headline: Emperor exercises option on Fiji prospect.

text.p: Fiji gold miner Emperor Mines Ltd said on Tuesday it had exercised its option to buy mine tenements held in the Tuvatu area of Fiji for A$5.15 million.

The purchase is to be funded via the issue of 2.594 million shares, Emperor said. "We have intensified exploration at the Tuvalu prospect, which has returned promising results," chief executive officer Colin Patterson said in a statement.
In the March quarter, the inferred mineral resource was updated to 176,000 ounces, Emperor said.

Extensive areas of brecciated sulphide mineralisation were intersected in TUDDH-76 and TUDDH-100, and are regarded as a significant indication of the potential for a rapid increase in tonnage for the prospect, the company said.
Emperor operates an underground mine at Vatukoula in the north west of the island producing 126,000 ounces a year.
